title: Day and Trial Passes: loyalty stamp eligibility per visit
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: whether a tier's visits count toward the chain's loyalty program, and the number of loyalty stamps earned per visit where they do.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | Loyalty stamp eligible | Loyalty stamps per visit |
|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | Yes | 1 |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | Yes | 1 |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | Yes | 1 |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | Yes | 1 |
| Monthly Trial Pass | Yes | 1 |
| Corporate Guest Pass | No | 0 |

Every tier except the Corporate Guest Pass counts its visits toward the chain's loyalty program, earning 1 loyalty stamp per visit. The Corporate Guest Pass is not loyalty-stamp eligible and earns 0 stamps per visit.
